## R Markdown


This analysis reprocesses human AD and non-demented control (NC) nuclei from Lau et al.deposited on GEO GSE157827. 

```{r packages}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
  library(Matrix)
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(celda)
  library(scDblFinder)
  library(harmony)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
  library(tibble)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(tidyr)
  library(writexl)
})
```

## 1. Data import, quality control, ambient RNA correction, and doublet removal

```{r}
base_dir <- "data/Human_AD_Lau2020_singlenuclear_files_110525" 
stopifnot(dir.exists(base_dir))

sample_dirs <- list.dirs(base_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
stopifnot(length(sample_dirs) > 0)

infer_condition <- function(id) {
  if (!grepl("^(AD|NC)", id)) stop("Unexpected sample prefix: ", id)
  ifelse(startsWith(id, "AD"), "AD", "NC")
}

#make samples into Seurat list
seurat_list_raw <- list()
for (sd in sample_dirs) {
  sid <- basename(sd)
  message("Reading ", sid)
  mtx <- Read10X(sd)  # expects barcodes.tsv.gz, features.tsv.gz, matrix.mtx.gz
  s <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = mtx, project = "Lau2020_humanAD")
  s$sample <- sid
  s$condition <- infer_condition(sid)
  s[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(s, pattern = "^MT-")
  seurat_list_raw[[sid]] <- s
}
saveRDS(seurat_list_raw, "snrna_raw_objs_human_AD_Lau2020.rds")

##sample QC
seurat_list_qc <- lapply(names(seurat_list_raw), function(sid){
  s <- seurat_list_raw[[sid]]
  subset(s, subset =
           nFeature_RNA >= 300 &
           nFeature_RNA <= 8000 &
           nCount_RNA   >= 500 &
           nCount_RNA   <= 40000 &
           percent.mt   <= 5)
})
names(seurat_list_qc) <- names(seurat_list_raw)


qc_summary_qc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(seurat_list_qc), function(sid) {
  s <- seurat_list_qc[[sid]]
  data.frame(
    sample = sid,
    cells = ncol(s),
    median_nFeature = median(s$nFeature_RNA),
    median_nCount   = median(s$nCount_RNA),
    median_percent_mt = if ("percent.mt" %in% colnames(s[[]])) median(s$percent.mt) else NA_real_
  )
}))
qc_summary_qc

##Decontx ambient RNA removal
decontx_results <- lapply(names(seurat_list_qc), function(sid) {
  s <- seurat_list_qc[[sid]]

  orig_counts <- GetAssayData(s, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")
  orig_per_cell <- Matrix::colSums(orig_counts)

  sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(s)
  # threads=1 inside; parallelism is over samples
  sce <- decontX(sce)

  decon_counts <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(sce, "decontXcounts")
  contam       <- SummarizedExperiment::colData(sce)$decontX_contamination
  new_per_cell <- Matrix::colSums(decon_counts)
  frac_removed <- 1 - (new_per_cell / orig_per_cell[colnames(decon_counts)])

  s2 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = decon_counts, assay = "RNA")
  s2 <- AddMetaData(s2, as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(sce)))
  s2$sample <- s$sample[colnames(s2)]
  s2$condition <- s$condition[colnames(s2)]
  s2$decontX_frac_removed <- frac_removed[colnames(s2)]
  s2[["RNA_raw"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = orig_counts[, colnames(s2), drop = FALSE])

  # drop highly contaminated cells
  s2 <- subset(s2, subset = decontX_contamination <= 0.20)

  list(
    seurat = s2,
    per_cell = data.frame(
      cell = colnames(s2),
      sample = s2$sample,
      decontX_contam = s2$decontX_contamination,
      decontX_frac_removed = s2$decontX_frac_removed,
      orig_counts = orig_per_cell[colnames(s2)],
      new_counts  = new_per_cell[colnames(s2)]
    )
  )
})
seurat_list_decontx <- setNames(lapply(decontx_results, `[[`, "seurat"), names(seurat_list_qc))

decontx_percell_tbl <- do.call(rbind, lapply(decontx_results, `[[`, "per_cell"))

##Remove doublets with scDBLFinder
seurat_list_clean <- lapply(names(seurat_list_decontx), function(sid) {
  s <- seurat_list_decontx[[sid]]
  sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(s)
  sce <- scDblFinder(sce)
  sce <- sce[, sce$scDblFinder.class == "singlet"]

  s2 <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = SummarizedExperiment::assay(sce, "counts"),
    assay  = "RNA"
  )
  s2 <- AddMetaData(s2, as.data.frame(colData(sce)))
  # carry sample/condition post-subset
  if (!"sample" %in% colnames(s2[[]]))    s2$sample <- s$sample[colnames(s2)]
  if (!"condition" %in% colnames(s2[[]])) s2$condition <- s$condition[colnames(s2)]
  # keep raw counts subset
  s2[["RNA_raw"]] <- CreateAssayObject(GetAssayData(s, assay = "RNA_raw", layer = "counts")[, colnames(s2), drop = FALSE])
  s2
})
names(seurat_list_clean) <- names(seurat_list_decontx)

dbl_stats <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(seurat_list_clean), function(sid) {
  data.frame(
    sample = sid,
    singlets = ncol(seurat_list_clean[[sid]]),
    removed_doublets = ncol(seurat_list_decontx[[sid]]) - ncol(seurat_list_clean[[sid]])
  )
}))

print(dbl_stats)

##rechecking qc
qc_simple <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(seurat_list_clean), function(sid) {
  s <- seurat_list_clean[[sid]]
  if (!"percent.mt" %in% colnames(s[[]])) {
    s[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(s, "^MT-")
  }
  data.frame(
    sample = sid,
    cells = ncol(s),
    median_nFeature = median(s$nFeature_RNA),
    median_nCount   = median(s$nCount_RNA),
    median_percent_mt = median(s$percent.mt)
  )
}))

qc_simple

##making violin plots of new qc data
qc_merge <- merge(
  seurat_list_clean[[1]],
  seurat_list_clean[-1],
  add.cell.ids = names(seurat_list_clean)
)

VlnPlot(
  qc_merge,
  features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
  group.by = "sample",
  ncol = 3,
  pt.size = 0
) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))


##removing bad samples (low cell numbers (AD6,NC11)low nfeature and nCount (NC16))
drop_now <- c("AD6","NC11", "NC16")
seurat_list_clean <- seurat_list_clean[setdiff(names(seurat_list_clean), drop_now)]
```

## 2. Global integration, cluster identification, and astrocyte selection 

```{r}
##Merge remaining good samples that passed qc
merged_clean <- merge(x = seurat_list_clean[[1]], y = seurat_list_clean[-1], add.cell.ids = names(seurat_list_clean))
DefaultAssay(merged_clean) <- "RNA"

merged_clean <- NormalizeData(merged_clean, scale.factor = 1e4, verbose = FALSE)
merged_clean <- FindVariableFeatures(merged_clean, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 3000, verbose = FALSE)
merged_clean <- ScaleData(merged_clean, features = VariableFeatures(merged_clean),
                          vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA"), verbose = TRUE)
merged_clean <- RunPCA(merged_clean, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)

#Extract PCA embeddings 
pca_embeddings <- Embeddings(merged_clean, "pca")

#Run Harmony on sample
harmony_embeddings <- HarmonyMatrix(
  data_mat  = pca_embeddings,
  meta_data = merged_clean@meta.data,
  vars_use  = "sample",
  do_pca    = FALSE,
  theta     = 2        
)

# Store Harmony back into Seurat object
merged_clean[["harmony"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = harmony_embeddings,
  key = "harmony_",
  assay = DefaultAssay(merged_clean)
)

#Find Neighbors, cluster, UMAP
dims_use <- 1:20
merged_clean <- FindNeighbors(merged_clean, reduction = "harmony", dims = dims_use, k.param = 50)
merged_clean <- FindClusters(merged_clean, resolution = 0.2, algorithm = 1, random.seed = 1234)
merged_clean <- RunUMAP(merged_clean, reduction = "harmony", dims = dims_use, seed.use = 1234)

##visualize astrocyte clusters
DimPlot(merged_clean, group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, raster = TRUE)

##Figure S1A
FeaturePlot(
  merged_clean,
  features = c("GFAP", "AQP4", "ALDH1L1"),
  reduction = "umap",
  cols = c("grey90", "red"),
  raster = TRUE,
  ncol = 3
)

##labeling astrocyte cluster (here cluster2)
# Rename clusters (keep all others numeric)
new.ids <- as.character(Idents(merged_clean))
new.ids[new.ids == "2"] <- "Astrocytes"
merged_clean$celltype <- factor(new.ids)

##labeling astrocyte cluster in all cell UMAP
##UMAP with astrocyte cluster labled
#part of Figure 1A
astro_cells <- WhichCells(merged_clean, idents = "2")

p <- DimPlot(
  merged_clean,
  group.by        = "seurat_clusters",
  cells.highlight = list(Astrocytes = astro_cells),
  cols            = c("grey60", "red"),
  reduction       = "umap",
  pt.size         = 0.5,
  sizes.highlight = 0.5,
  raster          = TRUE
) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  ggtitle("")

# get cluster centroid and move label slightly above
centroid <- colMeans(Embeddings(merged_clean, "umap")[astro_cells, , drop = FALSE])
p <- p + annotate(
  "text",
  x = centroid[1],
  y = centroid[2] + 5,          #move label up (adjust as needed)
  label = "Astrocytes",
  color = "red",
  fontface = 2,
  size = 5
)

p
```

## 3. Astrocyte re-integration, subclusters, and CXCL14 feature plots

```{r}
##subsetting astrocytes (cluster 2)
# Ensure Idents are the clustering labels you just made
Idents(merged_clean) <- "seurat_clusters"

# Grab astrocyte cells from cluster "2"
astro_cells <- WhichCells(merged_clean, idents = "2")

# Subset object
astro <- subset(merged_clean, cells = astro_cells)

# Optional tidy-up
astro$celltype <- "Astrocyte"
astro <- DietSeurat(astro, counts = TRUE, data = TRUE, scale.data = FALSE)

##processing astrocytes subset
DefaultAssay(astro) <- "RNA"

# QC covariates 
vars_to_regress <- c("nCount_RNA", "percent.mt")

astro <- NormalizeData(astro, scale.factor = 1e4, verbose = FALSE)
astro <- FindVariableFeatures(astro, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 3000, verbose = FALSE)
astro <- ScaleData(astro, features = VariableFeatures(astro), vars.to.regress = vars_to_regress, verbose = TRUE)
astro <- RunPCA(astro, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)

# keep a safe sample column for Harmony
if (!"sample" %in% colnames(astro@meta.data)) astro$sample <- astro$orig.ident

# Harmony on sample
astro_harm <- HarmonyMatrix(
  data_mat  = Embeddings(astro, "pca"),
  meta_data = astro@meta.data,
  vars_use  = "sample",
  do_pca    = FALSE,
  theta     = 2
)
astro[["harmony"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(embeddings = astro_harm, key = "harmony_", assay = DefaultAssay(astro))

# Neighbors / clustering / UMAP
dims_use <- 1:20
astro <- FindNeighbors(astro, reduction = "harmony", dims = dims_use, k.param = 30)
astro <- FindClusters(astro, resolution = 0.3, algorithm = 1, random.seed = 1234)
astro <- RunUMAP(astro, reduction = "harmony", dims = dims_use, seed.use = 1234)


DimPlot(astro, group.by = "seurat_clusters", 
        label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5)

FeaturePlot(
  merged_clean,
  features = c("GFAP", "AQP4", "ALDH1L1"),
  reduction = "umap",
  cols = c("grey90", "red"),
  raster = TRUE,
  ncol = 3
)

##plotting astro subclusters by condition
#Figure S1B
astro$condition <- merged_clean$condition[Cells(astro)]
table(astro$condition, useNA = "ifany")


astro$condition <- factor(astro$condition, levels = c("NC","AD"))

# Make sure Idents are clusters
Idents(astro) <- "seurat_clusters"

# Split UMAP by condition
p <- DimPlot(
  astro,
  group.by   = "seurat_clusters",
  split.by   = "condition",
  label      = TRUE,
  repel      = TRUE,
  pt.size    = 0.5,
  ncol       = 2
)
p

##2 umaps of cxcl14 by condition with proper legend
##Figure 1B
# common limits so both panels share the same legend/scale
cx <- FetchData(astro, "CXCL14")[,1]
lims <- quantile(cx, c(0, 1), na.rm = TRUE)

# split the object once
astro_nc <- subset(astro, subset = condition == "NC")
astro_ad <- subset(astro, subset = condition == "AD")

base_fp <- function(obj, title){
  FeaturePlot(obj, features = "CXCL14", order = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "grey90", high = "blue",
                         name = "CXCL14", limits = lims, oob = scales::squish) +
    ggtitle(title) +
    labs(x = "umap_1", y = "umap_2") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right",
      axis.text       = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks      = element_line(color = "black")
    )
}

p_nc <- base_fp(astro_nc, "NC")
p_ad <- base_fp(astro_ad, "AD")

(p_nc | p_ad) + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
```

## 4. CXCL14-positive nuclei, cluster markers, and state annotation 

```{r}
###Extract %CXCL14 positive astrocyte per sample/condition
#RNA assay (log-normalized counts)
DefaultAssay(astro) <- "RNA"

# Create a binary TRUE/FALSE for expression > 0
astro$CXCL14_pos <- FetchData(astro, "CXCL14")[, 1] > 0
cxcl14_summary <- astro@meta.data %>%
  group_by(condition, sample) %>%
  summarise(
    total_cells = n(),
    cxcl14_pos  = sum(CXCL14_pos),
    percent_pos = 100 * cxcl14_pos / total_cells
  ) %>%
  arrange(condition, desc(percent_pos))

cxcl14_summary

##Findmarkers for each astrocyte subcluster
##findmarkers to define each subcluster
DefaultAssay(astro) <- "RNA"   
Idents(astro) <- "seurat_clusters"

astro <- JoinLayers(astro, assay = "RNA")
cluster_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  astro,
  only.pos        = TRUE,
  min.pct         = 0.10,       
  logfc.threshold = 0.10,
  test.use        = "wilcox",
  layer           = "data"      # v5: be explicit after JoinLayers
)

# Top 10 per cluster
top20 <- cluster_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 20) %>%
  ungroup()

astro@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample, condition, seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(n=n()) %>%
  group_by(sample, condition) %>%
  mutate(prop = n/sum(n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=seurat_clusters, y=prop, fill=condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA, alpha=0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width=0.2, size=1) +
  theme_classic()



##comparing cxcl14 expression in only cxcl14 positive astrocytes between NC and AD
# Make sure you have CXCL14 expression values
astro$CXCL14_expr <- FetchData(astro, "CXCL14")[,1]

# Filter only CXCL14-positive astrocytes and summarize by sample
cxcl14_avg_pos <- astro@meta.data %>%
  filter(CXCL14_expr > 0) %>%
  group_by(sample, condition) %>%
  summarise(mean_CXCL14 = mean(CXCL14_expr, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_CXCL14 = median(CXCL14_expr, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_pos_cells = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

cxcl14_avg_pos

##filtering out samples with less than 40 cxcl14 positive
cxcl14_avg_pos_filtered <- cxcl14_avg_pos %>%
  filter(n_pos_cells >= 40)

cxcl14_avg_pos_filtered %>%
  count(condition)


```

## 5. Balanced NC CXCL14-positive vs CXCL14-negative astrocytes

```{r}
##comparing cxcl14- to cxcl14+ astrocytes in NC CTX
set.seed(42)
DefaultAssay(astro) <- "RNA"

# 1) Ensure CXCL14_pos exists (TRUE/FALSE) and keep only NC
if (is.null(astro$CXCL14_pos)) {
  astro$CXCL14_pos <- FetchData(astro, "CXCL14")[, 1] > 0
}
astro_nc <- subset(astro, subset = condition == "NC")

# 2) Per-sample exact balancing: n_pos = n_neg (per sample)
keep_cells <- unlist(lapply(split(colnames(astro_nc), astro_nc$sample), function(cells_samp) {
  pos <- cells_samp[ astro_nc$CXCL14_pos[cells_samp] ]
  neg <- cells_samp[ !astro_nc$CXCL14_pos[cells_samp] ]

  if (length(pos) == 0 || length(neg) == 0) return(character(0))  # skip if one group absent

  n <- min(length(pos), length(neg))  # exact match per sample
  c(sample(pos, n), sample(neg, n))
}), use.names = FALSE)

##balanced number of cxcl14+ and cxcl14- astrocytes per sample
astro_nc_bal <- subset(astro_nc, cells = keep_cells)

# quick check (each row should have equal TRUE/FALSE counts)
table(astro_nc_bal$sample, astro_nc_bal$CXCL14_pos)

# 3) Label groups and run DE
astro_nc_bal$Group <- ifelse(astro_nc_bal$CXCL14_pos, "CXCL14_pos", "CXCL14_neg")
Idents(astro_nc_bal) <- "Group"
```

## 6. NC CXCL14-positive vs negative differential expression and GO:BP GSEA (Figure S1F)

```{r}
##pathway analysis for cxcl14+ vs cxcl14- astrocytes in NC patients
##NC pos vs neg
de_nc <- FindMarkers(
  astro_nc_bal,
  ident.1 = "CXCL14_pos",
  ident.2 = "CXCL14_neg",
  test.use = "wilcox",
  min.pct = 0.05,
  logfc.threshold = 0
)
de_nc_all <- de_nc
ranks_df <- de_nc %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  mutate(rank = sign(avg_log2FC) * -log10(p_val + 1e-300)) %>%
  filter(!gene %in% c("CXCL14")) %>%                      # <- exclude marker(s)
  arrange(desc(rank)) %>%
  distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

geneList <- setNames(ranks_df$rank, ranks_df$gene)
geneList <- sort(geneList, decreasing = TRUE)
ego_gsea <- gseGO(
  geneList      = geneList,
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType       = "SYMBOL",
  ont           = "BP",
  minGSSize     = 20,
  maxGSSize     = 500,
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  verbose       = FALSE
)

# Reduce redundancy (GO-only)
ego_gsea_slim <- simplify(
  ego_gsea,
  cutoff     = 0.7,     # 0.5–0.7 typical; higher = more aggressive pruning
  by         = "p.adjust",
  select_fun = min,
  measure    = "Wang"
)

#Make term gene lists readable (ENTREZ -> SYMBOL)
# gseGO above used keyType = "SYMBOL"; pathways are already gene-symbol based.
# Original script called setReadable(..., keyType = "ENTREZID"), which is
# inconsistent here. Omitted to prevent incorrect identifier conversion.


res <- ego_gsea_slim   

res_tbl   <- as.data.frame(res@result) %>% filter(!is.na(NES))


###exporting pathways
##exporting pathway list
to_df <- function(x) {
  if (is.data.frame(x)) x else as.data.frame(x@result)
}

gsea_df <- to_df(ego_gsea_slim)

gsea_pos <- gsea_df %>% filter(NES > 0)
gsea_neg <- gsea_df %>% filter(NES < 0)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    CXCL14_pos_enriched = gsea_pos,
    CXCL14_neg_enriched = gsea_neg
  ),
  path = "CXCL14_GSEA_GO_BP_slim.xlsx"
)

##pathway barplot
##barplot NES on x-axis, color by -log p-value
res_tbl <- as.data.frame(res@result) %>%
  filter(!is.na(NES))

plot_df <- as.data.frame(res@result) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(NES), NES > 0) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    neglog10padj = -log10(p.adjust),
    Description  = stringr::str_to_sentence(Description)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(NES) |>
  dplyr::slice_tail(n = 10) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Description = factor(Description, levels = Description)
  )

###Figure S1F
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = NES, y = Description, fill = neglog10padj)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "viridis",
    name = expression(-log[10]("adjusted p-value"))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "NES",
    y = NULL
   
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", color = "black")
  )
```

## 7. NC CXCL14-positive vs negative selected marker dot plot 

```{r}
##dotplot for genes of interest from pathway analysis between CXCL14+ and CXCL14- NC astrocytes
obj <- astro_nc_bal
group_col <- "Group"

genes_list <- list(
  "Homeostasis" = c("AQP4","SLC1A2","SLC1A3","CST3","VIM","GJA1"),
  "Detoxification" = c("SOD3","MT1E","PRDX1","SESN1"),
  "Vascular interaction" = c("ATP1B2","SLC15A2","SLC6A1","ATP8A1"),
  "Amyloid-beta clearance" = c("APOE","CLU","LRP1","RAB11A")
)

# keep only genes present
genes_list <- lapply(genes_list, function(g) intersect(g, rownames(obj)))
features <- unlist(genes_list, use.names = FALSE)

# set Group order (edit labels to match your meta exactly)
obj@meta.data[[group_col]] <- factor(obj@meta.data[[group_col]],
                                     levels = c("CXCL14_pos", "CXCL14_neg"))

# mapping gene -> category (facet strip)
gene2cat <- stack(genes_list) %>% rename(Gene = values, Category = ind)

# base DotPlot
p <- DotPlot(
  obj,
  features = features,
  group.by = group_col,
  assay = DefaultAssay(obj)
)

# Assign gene categories once and preserve requested gene ordering.
pd <- p$data %>%
  left_join(gene2cat, by = c("features.plot" = "Gene")) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = factor(Category, levels = names(genes_list)),
    features.plot = factor(
      features.plot,
      levels = unlist(lapply(names(genes_list), function(ct) rev(genes_list[[ct]])))
    )
  )

pd_facet <- pd %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  mutate(
    avg_exp_facet_scaled = scales::rescale(avg.exp)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

###Figure S1G
ggplot(pd_facet, aes(x = id, y = features.plot)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = pct.exp, color = avg_exp_facet_scaled)) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(Category),
    scales = "free_y",
    space  = "free_y",
    switch = "y"
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    name = "Relative expression (within pathway)"
  ) +
  scale_size(range = c(1.5, 7), name = "Percent expressed") +
  labs(x = "Group", y = "Genes") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
    strip.text.y.left  = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )+ scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      CXCL14_pos = "CXCL14+ astrocytes",
      CXCL14_neg = "CXCL14- astrocytes"
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.x       = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x      = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y      = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold")
  )+ theme(
    strip.placement  = "outside",
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )
```

## 8. AD versus NC CXCL14-positive astrocytes: selection

```{r}
##analyzing CXCL14+ astrocytes between NC and AD
DefaultAssay(astro) <- "RNA"

#  Define CXCL14_pos 
if (is.null(astro$CXCL14_pos)) {
  astro$CXCL14_pos <- FetchData(astro, "CXCL14")[, 1] > 0
}

#  Subset ONLY CXCL14+ astrocytes
astro_pos <- subset(astro, subset = CXCL14_pos == TRUE)
```

## 9. AD versus NC CXCL14-positive astrocytes: differential expression, ORA and redundancy pruning 

```{r}
##pathway analysis
#findmarkers between cxcl14 positive astrocytes in AD vs NC, only used samples with >40 positive astrocytes
## Keep only samples with ≥ 40 CXCL14+ cells (within astro_pos)
sample_counts <- astro_pos@meta.data %>% count(sample, name = "n_cells")
keep_samples  <- sample_counts %>% filter(n_cells >= 40) %>% pull(sample)

astro_pos_filt <- subset(astro_pos, subset = sample %in% keep_samples)

cat("Kept", length(keep_samples), "samples; total cells:",
    ncol(astro_pos_filt), "\n")

##Make sure the comparison groups are exactly 'NC' and 'AD'

cond_levels <- levels(factor(astro_pos_filt$condition))
cond_levels

if (all(c("ND","AD") %in% cond_levels) && !"NC" %in% cond_levels) {
  astro_pos_filt$condition <- factor(replace(astro_pos_filt$condition,
                                             astro_pos_filt$condition == "ND", "NC"))
}
astro_pos_filt$condition <- factor(astro_pos_filt$condition, levels = c("NC","AD"))

##Set identities to condition (or use group.by in FindMarkers)
Idents(astro_pos_filt) <- "condition"
table(Idents(astro_pos_filt))

de_pos_AD_vs_NC <- FindMarkers(
  object          = astro_pos_filt,
  ident.1         = "AD",
  ident.2         = "NC",
  test.use        = "wilcox",
  min.pct         = 0.10,        
  logfc.threshold = 0            
)


##ORA
##ORA on cxcl14 pos AD vs NC - using top500 ranked up and down by logfoldchange
# prep DE results
de_tbl <- de_pos_AD_vs_NC %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene")

N <- 500  
up_genes <- de_tbl %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > 0) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = N) %>% dplyr::pull(gene)

down_genes <- de_tbl %>%
  dplyr::arrange(avg_log2FC) %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC < 0) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = N) %>% dplyr::pull(gene)

length(up_genes); length(down_genes)

ego_up <- enrichGO(
  gene          = up_genes,
  
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType       = "SYMBOL",
  ont           = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.25,
  readable      = TRUE
)

ego_down <- enrichGO(
  gene          = down_genes,
 
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType       = "SYMBOL",
  ont           = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.25,
  readable      = TRUE
)


###simplifying pathways, consolidating similar redundent ones

simplify_by_jaccard <- function(ego, sim_cut = 0.4, min_cluster_size = 1) {
  if (is.null(ego) || nrow(as.data.frame(ego)) == 0) return(ego)
  
  # make sure it’s a data.frame 
  df <- as.data.frame(ego)
  rownames(df) <- df$ID
  
  # compute Jaccard matrix
  jaccard_mat <- function(geneID_vec_named) {
    sets <- lapply(geneID_vec_named, function(x) unique(strsplit(x, "/")[[1]]))
    ids  <- names(sets)
    n    <- length(sets)
    M <- matrix(0, n, n, dimnames = list(ids, ids))
    for (i in seq_len(n)) {
      Si <- sets[[i]]
      for (j in i:n) {
        Sj <- sets[[j]]
        inter <- length(intersect(Si, Sj))
        uni   <- length(union(Si, Sj))
        M[i, j] <- M[j, i] <- if (uni == 0) 0 else inter / uni
      }
    }
    M
  }
  
  J <- jaccard_mat(stats::setNames(df$geneID, df$ID))
  dist_obj <- as.dist(1 - J)
  hc <- hclust(dist_obj, method = "average")
  cl <- cutree(hc, h = 1 - sim_cut)
  df$cluster <- cl
  
  # pick representative term per cluster
  reps <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p.adjust, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(is_representative = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(ID, cluster, is_representative)
  
  df2 <- dplyr::left_join(df, reps, by = c("ID","cluster")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(is_representative = ifelse(is.na(is_representative), FALSE, is_representative))
  
  keep_clusters <- df2 %>% dplyr::count(cluster, name = "size") %>%
    dplyr::filter(size >= min_cluster_size) %>% dplyr::pull(cluster)
  df2 <- df2 %>% dplyr::filter(cluster %in% keep_clusters)
  
  df_rep <- df2 %>% dplyr::filter(is_representative) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p.adjust)
  
  df_rep
}


## Run simplification ----
ego_up_simple   <- simplify_by_jaccard(ego_up,   sim_cut = 0.3) 
ego_down_simple <- simplify_by_jaccard(ego_down, sim_cut = 0.8)
```

## 11. ORA bar plots 

```{r}
##plotting pathways
##Figure 1E
make_ora_barplot <- function(x, n = 10,
                             x_axis = c("Count", "GeneRatio"),
                             padj_col = "p.adjust") {
  x_axis <- match.arg(x_axis)

  # Accept either enrichResult/gseaResult OR data.frame
  df <- if (is.data.frame(x)) x else as.data.frame(x@result)
  stopifnot(padj_col %in% colnames(df))

  df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[padj_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      neglog10padj = -log10(.data[[padj_col]]),
      Description  = stringr::str_to_sentence(Description),
      # Fix acronyms AFTER sentence-casing
      Description  = gsub("\\batp\\b", "ATP", Description, ignore.case = TRUE)
    )

  # Choose x variable
  if (x_axis == "GeneRatio") {
    if (!("GeneRatio" %in% colnames(df))) stop("No GeneRatio column found.")
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(GeneRatioNum = sapply(GeneRatio, function(gr) {
        parts <- strsplit(as.character(gr), "/")[[1]]
        as.numeric(parts[1]) / as.numeric(parts[2])
      }))
    x_var <- "GeneRatioNum"
  } else {
    if (!("Count" %in% colnames(df))) stop("No Count column found.")
    x_var <- "Count"
  }

  # Build plot df
  plot_df <- df %>%
    arrange(desc(.data[[x_var]])) %>%
    slice_head(n = n) %>%
    mutate(Description = factor(Description, levels = rev(Description)))

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = .data[[x_var]], y = Description, fill = neglog10padj)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = "viridis",
      name = expression(-log[10]("adjusted p-value"))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = ifelse(x_axis == "Count", "Number of overlapping genes", "Gene ratio"),
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", color = "black"))
}

p_up   <- make_ora_barplot(ego_up_simple,   n = 10, x_axis = "Count")
p_down <- make_ora_barplot(ego_down_simple, n = 8, x_axis = "Count")

p_up
p_down
